title: Warm Greek Yellow Split Peas Gigantes Plaki
description: A hearty and earthy Greek dish featuring yellow split peas, this gigantes plaki is a kid-friendly and satvik-friendly option, perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is made by poaching the peas in a flavorful broth and serving them in a rich and tangy tomato sauce.
instructions: Rinse the yellow split peas and soak them in water for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Drain and rinse the peas, then transfer them to a large pot with 4 cups of water.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the peas for 45 minutes, or until they are tender.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the canned crushed tomatoes, salt, black pepper, and dried oregano, and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, while the peas are cooking.
Once the peas are done, drain them and add them to the tomato sauce.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top and stir to combine.
Serve the gigantes plaki hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or dill if desired.
